BTC 365d rolling VWAP: ~82.4K HTF pivot

Technical level identification on BTC 1D chart. 365-day rolling VWAP anchored from yearly open positioned at ~82.4K. Stoiiic notes: last time BTC traded above this level was November 2025.

Chart shows multi-level technical structure with support/resistance zones marked. This level aligns with group's 80-83K resistance cluster (KillaXBT sell-wall structure, Stoiiic VWAP, Wild_Randomness level confluence).
